data.name: Logix Mouse — two buttons and two rollers

introduced.event_name: NCC June 1982 — colour graphics and mouse interaction

specification.tracking: Relative X/Y pointing; mechanical ball with quadrature encoders is the design baseline, subject to resolution and tracking qualification.
specification.ergonomics: Rollers are independent of primary/secondary buttons; qualify accidental actuation, handedness, detent force and reach. Side-wheel placement must be documented.
specification.power: Port-power target; current draw, connector and protection must be qualified.
specification.history: Deliberate alternate-history dual-roller mouse design, not a claim of a matching historical 1982 retail product.
